title: Balushahi
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Pani (Water) ¼ Cup or as required

steps.instruction: In saucepan,add sugar and water,mix well and cook on low flame until sugar is dissolved and continue cook until syrup becomes thick.
steps.romanUrdu: Saucepan mein cheeni aur pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur halki ancch per cheeni dissolves ho janay aur sheera garha hunay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add lemon juice,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan mix karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,place sifter,add all-purpose flour,baking soda and sift together.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein sifter rakh dein,maida aur baking soda dal ker ek saath sift ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add nutmeg powder,cardamom powder,salt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Jaifil powder,elaichi powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.
Ghee dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add yogurt and mix well until crumbled.
steps.romanUrdu: Dahi shamil karein aur crumbled hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and mix until combined (don’t over knead),cover and let it rest for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein (don’t over knead) aur dhak ker 15 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Grease hands and working surface with oil and flatten the dough & roll it.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon aur working surface ko oil sa grease karein aur dough ko flat ker lein phir roll ker lein.

steps.instruction: Cut the dough with the help of the cutter.
steps.romanUrdu: Cutter ki madad sa dough ko cut ker lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough,make a ball and with the help of the thumb press from the center.
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein aur ball bana lein aur thumb ki madad sa center ko press ker lein.

steps.instruction: In wok,add ghee and let it melt,fry dough on low flame for 20-25 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein ghee garam karein aur dough ko halki ancch per 20-25 minutes kliya fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: After frying,add bhalo shahi in warm sugar syrup (sheera) and leave them for 10-15 minutes and take out in a serving plate.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying ka bad bhalo shahi ko warm sheera mein 10-15 minutes kliya dal dein aur serving plate mein nikal lein.
Pista sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: The perfect Homemade Balushahi recipe for you. Make it and impress everyone. #HappyCookingToYou
